 We're changing auto mode to no longer charge for classifier requests in
 Claude Code.

 However, this session isn't eligible because your requests go through
 gateway.example, which isn't compatible with this update.

 Nothing breaks: auto mode keeps working, and its classifier requests are
 billed as before.

 To fix it and access the new version of auto mode, ask your gateway to
 implement: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
